Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
(D) actions directed at Etienne cost 1 additional blood.

When you perform a D action that targets minions you control, it becomes an
Undirected action. I know that.
I know that you wouldn't pay an extra blood to rescue him from torpor with
one of your own minions, but what about a cross-table rescue action? If
this costs one additional blood, can the extra one blood be paid by Etienne,
or does it have to come off of the acting minion?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The cost of a rescue action can be split any way the Methuselah chooses (and
therefore the acting vampire's controller could choose to have Etienne pay
all three blood)
